title: Starting — Air Starter Supply Duct Clamping and Start Valve Position Switch Installation
abstract: Retrofit of the two-piece spherical-seat duct clamp and the discrete start valve position switch, recovering the mass flow lost to joint fretting and giving the crew a positive indication of valve state.

sections.planning_reason: Twenty-three operators reported starts running long in warm ambient conditions. Borescope inspection found the starter supply duct joint faces fretted at the forward clamp on nineteen of twenty-four engines examined. The leak is small enough to pass a ground leak check and large enough to cost about four per cent of the delivered mass flow, which at high ambient temperature is the difference between a normal start and a hung one. The valve gave only a pressure-derived indication, so a crew facing a slow start could not tell whether it had opened.
sections.description: The forward clamp is replaced by a two-piece item with a captive spherical seat that tolerates the angular misalignment the single-piece clamp did not, and the aft clamp is re-tensioned to a revised value. The joint face on the nozzle is re-machined and titanium bolts replace the original steel fasteners at all six positions so that the joint preload does not fall away with thermal cycling. A discrete position switch is added to the valve body and wired to the existing engine interface.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make sure that the engine is cold and open the fan cowls. WARNING: DO NOT OPEN THE FAN COWLS IN A CROSSWIND ABOVE THE LIMIT GIVEN IN THE MAINTENANCE MANUAL. Do AMM-S-80-10-11-000-040-A to remove the air starter motor and the supply duct. Do a borescope inspection of the duct joint faces and record the fretting depth. Re-machine the joint face on the nozzle WES955482-79 to the dimension in the accomplishment instructions. Install the two-piece clamp PE187919-09 with the spherical seat at the forward joint and torque the titanium bolts EN290030-3C to the value given. Re-tension the aft clamp D8010119758805. Install the position switch on the valve body and connect it to the spare pins in the engine interface connector. Renew the duct seal 5193ES and refit the firewall panel. Do AMM-S-80-10-11-400-040-A to install the air starter motor. Do a dry motoring run and confirm the valve open discrete. Repeat for the second engine.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-38 and SOLANO-39 aircraft with Auran 7000 engines that are not already at the two-piece clamp standard. Aircraft from MSN S01232 onward are post-modification from build. Both engines on one aircraft must be brought to the same standard within the same maintenance visit.
sections.material_note: Kit K8010-1003-01 covers one engine and contains both clamps, the bolt set, the switch and the harness tail. Two kits are needed per aircraft. Lead time is eighteen weeks. Removed clamps are returned for fretting analysis.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next engine shop visit, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
